versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI troubleshooting skill.

- Diagnose API call failures on Alibaba Cloud using request ID, error code, or error message.
- Guides through installing and verifying the required Aliyun CLI plugin (`aliyun-cli-openapiexplorer`).
- Enforces proper command formats and credential checks, with clear security rules.
- Automated CLI command construction with session-based user agent for observability.
- Provides structured diagnostic workflow to look up request logs and fetch official error code solutions.
- Surfaces permission issues and log-not-found cases with clear next steps.
